sents.t: Learn to cook simple Italian dishes at Olive Kitchen!
Our evening class meets every Wednesday from 7:00 to 9:00 P.M.
No experience is necessary; our chef explains each step clearly.
All ingredients are provided, and you can take home what you make.
Past students say the class is fun, although one of them still calls every pasta "spaghetti."
Sign up on our Web site by the 25th to get a 10 percent discount.
